text: Documented the complete compatibility matrix in docs/gale-integration.md. Current public interop normalizes owned and borrowed rank-1/rank-2 values by logical copy, including positive/negative strides, broadcast zero-strides, transposes, and empty dimensions. Mutable inputs have no direct overload; raw mutable destinations are rejected because no exclusive-borrow token exists. Copy outputs are alias-distinct by construction; any future raw descriptor would require public storage identity and checked Long reachable intervals. docsCheck passed (19 mdoc files).
